title: Lily Cleans Her Room
setting: A small, bright bedroom on a Sunday morning.

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair

sentences.en: On Sunday, Lily cleans her small bedroom.
sentences.zh: 星期天，莉莉打扫她的小卧室。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair holds a broom in a small, untidy bedroom.

sentences.en: She puts her clothes on the bed.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair puts a pile of clothes on her bed.

sentences.en: One sock is on the left side.
sentences.scene_prompt: A single striped sock lies on the left side of the bed; Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair points at it.

sentences.en: Should she keep this pretty skirt or that?
sentences.zh: 她该留下这条漂亮的裙子，还是那条？
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair holds up two pretty skirts, one in each hand, thinking.

sentences.en: The window glass is too dirty now.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair looks at a dusty, smeared window pane.

sentences.en: She cleans it once, and it shines.
sentences.zh: 她擦了一遍，窗户就亮了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair wipes the window with a cloth and the glass sparkles.

sentences.en: Then she sits down with some chips.
sentences.zh: 然后她拿着一些薯条坐下。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair sits on the bed with a small bowl of chips.

sentences.en: A clean room gives her a good feeling.
sentences.zh: 干净的房间让她心情很好。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, a girl of nine with long brown hair smiles happily in her clean, tidy bedroom.
